howto.title: How to play
howto.1: Make other words from the letters of the source word. Tap the letters in order, then tap the check mark.
howto.2: Each letter can be used as many times as it appears in the source word.
howto.3: Common Russian nouns in the singular, 3 letters or longer. The letters Е and Ё count as the same letter.
howto.4: Find half of the words on the list to complete the level. 75% of the words gives a second star, all words a third.
howto.5: A word that is not on the list may be a bonus word: it gives 1 coin.
howto.6: Hint reveals one letter of the shortest missing word. Shuffle rearranges the letters. Erase removes the last letter; press and hold to clear the word.
howto.7: Tap a used letter to remove it and every letter after it.
howto.keys: On a computer you can use the keyboard: letters in any layout, Enter to check, Backspace to erase, Space to shuffle.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.1: The game “{name}” does not request or collect your personal data: it does not need your name, phone number, address, contacts, photos or location.
privacy.2: Game progress (completed levels, coins, settings) is stored on your device. If you are signed in to the platform account, progress is also stored in its cloud so that it is available on all your devices.
privacy.3: Ads in the game are shown by the platform's advertising network. To show ads the platform may process technical device data (for example, an advertising identifier) under its own rules. The game has no access to this data.
privacy.4: Purchases are made and paid for through the platform. The game does not receive or store payment details.
privacy.5: To delete game data, clear the game data on your device or uninstall the game.
